beats.title: Augustus Becomes First Emperor
beats.description: Octavian is granted the title Augustus by the Senate, ending the Republic's civil wars and founding the imperial system.

beats.title: Tiberius Succeeds Augustus
beats.description: The stepson of the first emperor takes the throne after his death, proving that power could pass within a family.

beats.title: Caligula Becomes Emperor
beats.description: The young son of the popular Germanicus inherits the throne to great rejoicing, before a reign remembered for cruelty and excess.

beats.title: Claudius Is Raised by the Guard
beats.description: After an assassination, soldiers of the Praetorian Guard find a hiding uncle of the dead ruler and proclaim him emperor.

beats.title: Nero Becomes Emperor
beats.description: A teenage stepson of the previous ruler takes power, soon to be notorious as the emperor who fiddled while his city burned.

beats.title: Vespasian Ends the Four Emperors
beats.description: After a year of civil war and four rulers, a general from the East wins the throne and founds a new dynasty.

beats.title: Titus Becomes Emperor
beats.description: The conqueror of Jerusalem succeeds his father and almost at once faces a volcanic eruption and a great fire in the capital.

beats.title: Domitian Becomes Emperor
beats.description: The younger brother of the last ruler takes the throne and begins a reign that grows increasingly autocratic.

beats.title: Nerva Starts the Adoptive Emperors
beats.description: An elderly senator is chosen after a palace assassination, beginning a line of rulers who picked capable successors.

beats.title: Trajan Becomes Emperor
beats.description: A Spanish-born general is the first ruler from the provinces; under him the empire later reaches its greatest extent.

beats.title: Hadrian Becomes Emperor
beats.description: The cousin of the previous ruler takes power and soon turns to consolidating borders rather than conquering more land.

beats.title: Antoninus Pius Becomes Emperor
beats.description: Adopted by Hadrian shortly before his death, a calm and respected senator takes the throne for a long, peaceful reign.

beats.title: Marcus Aurelius Becomes Emperor
beats.description: The philosopher-ruler of the Meditations takes the throne, sharing it with an adoptive brother and soon facing plague and war.

beats.title: Commodus Becomes Emperor
beats.description: The son of a philosopher-emperor inherits the throne, ending the line of adopted heirs and fond of fighting in the arena.

beats.title: Septimius Severus Seizes the Throne
beats.description: An African-born general marches on the capital during a chaotic year of rivals and founds a long-lived military dynasty.

beats.title: Caracalla Rules Alone
beats.description: After the death of his father, the new ruler soon eliminates his brother and co-ruler to become sole emperor.

beats.title: Elagabalus Becomes Emperor
beats.description: A teenage priest of a Syrian sun god is proclaimed emperor by soldiers and brings eastern cults to the capital.

beats.title: Maximinus Thrax Begins the Crisis
beats.description: A giant soldier from the lower ranks is hailed by the army after its ruler is murdered, the first of many barracks emperors.

beats.title: Philip the Arab Becomes Emperor
beats.description: A Syrian-born prefect takes power after a campaign against Persia and later presides over the city's thousandth birthday.

beats.title: Decius Becomes Emperor
beats.description: A senator sent to quell a mutiny is proclaimed ruler by his troops and is later known for a persecution of Christians.

beats.title: Aurelian Becomes Emperor
beats.description: A hard soldier takes the throne in a time of breakaway provinces and sets about reuniting the fractured empire.

beats.title: Diocletian Becomes Emperor
beats.description: A soldier of humble Balkan origins takes power, ends decades of chaos and soon splits rule among several co-emperors.

beats.title: Constantine Is Hailed Emperor
beats.description: Troops at York proclaim the general emperor on his father's death, starting a rise that leads to a Christian empire.

beats.title: Julian the Apostate Takes Power
beats.description: The nephew of Constantine becomes sole emperor and tries to restore the old pagan cults in place of Christianity.
beats.note: Sole emperor on Constantius II's death; proclaimed Augustus by troops 360

beats.title: Theodosius I Becomes Emperor
beats.description: Named by his co-ruler in the East after a disastrous defeat by the Goths, he will be the last to rule the whole empire.

beats.title: Theodosius II Becomes Emperor
beats.description: A boy inherits the eastern throne and, under advisers, is later known for walls around his capital and a great law code.

beats.title: Romulus Augustulus Becomes Emperor
beats.description: A boy is placed on the western throne by his general father, and will be the last emperor to rule from Italy.

beats.title: Justinian Becomes Emperor
beats.description: The ruler who will codify Roman law and build the Hagia Sophia takes the throne in Constantinople alongside Theodora.

beats.title: Heraclius Becomes Emperor
beats.description: The son of a governor in Africa sails to Constantinople, overthrows a tyrant and then wrests the empire back from Persia.

beats.title: Leo III Becomes Emperor
beats.description: A general seizes the throne as Arab armies besiege the capital, and later launches the controversy over religious icons.

beats.title: Irene Rules Alone as Emperor
beats.description: After having her own son blinded and deposed, a woman governs the Byzantine realm in her own right, a first.

beats.title: Basil I Founds a Dynasty
beats.description: A peasant from the Balkans who rose through the court murders his patron and becomes emperor, founding a long dynasty.

beats.title: Constantine VII Becomes Emperor
beats.description: A scholarly boy, born in the purple chamber, is named ruler under regents and later writes books on court ceremony.

beats.title: Nikephoros II Takes the Throne
beats.description: The general who recaptured Crete marries the widowed empress and is crowned, pushing the empire's borders east.

beats.title: Basil II Becomes Emperor
beats.description: The future Bulgar-Slayer takes the throne and begins a long reign that brings the empire to its medieval peak.

beats.title: Alexios I Komnenos Seizes Power
beats.description: A young general takes Constantinople by force, then calls on the West for help, which leads to the First Crusade.

beats.title: John II Komnenos Becomes Emperor
beats.description: Called John the Good, the son of Alexios seizes power at his father's deathbed and wins back territory in Anatolia.

beats.title: Manuel I Komnenos Becomes Emperor
beats.description: A chivalrous, ambitious ruler takes the throne and spends his reign in campaigns from Italy to Egypt and against the Turks.

beats.title: Michael VIII Palaiologos Is Crowned
beats.description: A noble general in exile crowns himself co-emperor at Nicaea, and will recover Constantinople from the Latins.

beats.title: Manuel II Becomes Emperor
beats.description: A cultured ruler inherits a shrunken empire under Ottoman pressure and tours Western courts begging for help.

beats.title: Constantine XI Becomes Last Emperor
beats.description: The final Byzantine ruler is crowned and holds out in Constantinople until it falls to Ottoman cannon and siege.
